latestVersion.changelog:
tiktok-trend-radar 1.0.0

- Initial release of a fully automated TikTok and Instagram trend monitoring and content creation pipeline.
- Real-time scraping of trending hashtags and posts from TikTok and Instagram using Apify.
- Automatic detection of viral "hashtag explosions" and rapid trend surges.
- AI-driven trend analysis, content idea generation, and video script writing via Claude (OpenClaw).
- Auto-generation of ready-to-publish short videos through InVideo AI.
- Instant alerts via webhook, Slack, or email when new trends break.
